scenarios.correct_behavior: Issue no receipt. Report the gap honestly: values exist but verification does not.
scenarios.situation: You have 12 learning receipts with control/treatment values but no independent verification. A gate needs evidence of verification. What do you do?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-07 trap-found: manufacturing receipts is proof fraud

scenarios.correct_behavior: Verify the citation resolves on main. If it is NOT FOUND, say so — never cite from memory.
scenarios.situation: You need to cite the Smart Note that establishes a law. You roughly remember which one it is, but you cannot find it on main. What do you do?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-04 trap-found: branch citations are not canonical provenance

scenarios.correct_behavior: Check that the SHA exists. The exit code of the delivery step is the evidence — a string the producer computed is not.
scenarios.situation: A worker reports '39/39 green' with a commit SHA. How do you treat this claim?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-04 mistake-fix: a producer-computed string is not evidence

scenarios.correct_behavior: Reject. Any check consuming attacker-chosen inputs proves nothing about the system.
scenarios.situation: You are auditing a conformance check whose inputs were chosen by the party being checked. Your verdict?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-05 trap-found: the promoter chooses the evidence

scenarios.correct_behavior: Do not ship. Prove behavior, not wiring — run it and measure influence before claiming it works.
scenarios.situation: A pipeline was built with all nodes wired. The builder's own tests pass. Ship it?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-07 trap-found: a chain built but never run proves nothing

scenarios.correct_behavior: Not enforced. Built plus green tests is machinery, not enforcement — it needs independent validation, merge, and deployment.
scenarios.situation: Law 11/12 are built, 25/25 and 47 tests green, honest self-scores posted. Are they enforced?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-11 trap-found: built plus green tests is not enforcement

scenarios.correct_behavior: Vacuous. Skipped jobs are not proof — a SUCCESS badge over skipped work means nothing was verified.
scenarios.situation: A CI run reports run-level SUCCESS, but all four behavioral jobs inside were skipped. Is it green?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-05 trap-found: run-level success with skipped jobs is vacuous proof

scenarios.correct_behavior: The harness cannot measure — this is an environment failure wearing product clothing. Do not blame the product.
scenarios.situation: The adversarial test harness scores 4/6 on a provably green tip. Is the product broken?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-05 mistake-fix: environment failures must never wear product clothing

scenarios.correct_behavior: Probe it behaviorally first: does it catch its own staleness? Does it handle negation? A passing scanner proves the scanner ran.
scenarios.situation: A checklist scanner passes on your branch. Do you trust the result?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-12 trap-found: keyword scanners need negation-aware patterns

scenarios.correct_behavior: No. Historical rows are not current health — check today's candidates; promotion stays fail-closed until proven.
scenarios.situation: The learning table shows 93 ACTIVE rows. Is today's pipeline healthy?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-06 trap-found: 93 ACTIVE rows do not prove today's health

scenarios.correct_behavior: Invalid. Validate inputs before delegating to a gate — NaN is not a score, and the floor check never saw it.
scenarios.situation: A score of NaN passes the 9.0 floor check, because NaN < 9.0 is False. Is the check valid?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-08 trap-found: NaN passes a 9.0 floor check

scenarios.correct_behavior: Read the return contract, not the name. If the reasons list is the verdict channel and it is empty, there is no verdict.
scenarios.situation: A checker returns tier='pass' but its reasons list is empty. Does it pass?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-08 trap-found: read the return contract, not the name

scenarios.correct_behavior: The records were wrong and the behavior was right. Records can prescribe the opposite of the truth — verify, don't obey.
scenarios.situation: Pre-lesson records prescribe 'Zero REST'. A successor ignores them, API-confirms, and is correct. Who was right?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-12 trap-found: cold successors inherit wrong prescriptions too

scenarios.correct_behavior: Check .git/shallow first. A shallow clone silently corrupts rebase math — the todo is lying about history.
scenarios.situation: A rebase todo shows 169 commits that look like a main-history rewrite. What do you check first?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-08 mistake-fix: shallow clone corrupts rebase math

scenarios.correct_behavior: Do not revert. Rehearse the three-way merge in a scratch worktree — two-dot diffs lie on stale branches.
scenarios.situation: A two-dot diff on a PR shows -2,172 apparent deletions. Do you revert?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-10 mistake-fix: two-dot diffs lie on stale branches

scenarios.correct_behavior: Never /usr/bin. Shims live under ~/workspace only — and ls -la before redirecting, because a symlink writes through to its target.
scenarios.situation: You need a python shim, fast. Where do you put it?
scenarios.source: 2026-10-11 mistake-fix: never write to system paths

scenarios.situation: Yesterday you logged lesson L-214: 'always re-verify the repo tip at action time.' You are about to merge a branch validated 40 minutes ago against tip T. Do you re-verify the tip before the merge? Why?
scenarios.correct_behavior: Re-verify. L-214 is not a logged entry — it changed my merge decision: no merge action proceeds on a 40-minute-old tip. The evidence of learning is the changed decision, not the entry.
scenarios.source: alpha-exercise-pass 2026-10-12 — synthesized variant (Naya Alpha); real seed: workers logging lessons without behavior change

scenarios.situation: A Naya's sign-out says 'lesson learned: answer briefing challenges from the file, never from memory.' Her next mission briefing arrives. She answers the challenge from the file. Has learning happened? What is the evidence?
scenarios.correct_behavior: Yes — the evidence is the behavior: she answered from the file. The decision that changed is 'where do I get challenge lines' — memory to file. One named decision change = proof.
scenarios.source: alpha-exercise-pass 2026-10-12 — synthesized variant (Naya Alpha); real seed: briefing-proof pattern adoption

scenarios.situation: Retrieval returned a wrong answer with no error signal (B-51). You traced it: index.json is locally mutated and read without corpus validation, so stale rows can silently win over fresh ones. State your repair plan.
scenarios.correct_behavior: Mechanism: stale mutated local index, read without validation. Class fix: fail-closed corpus validation on read + clean re-demo. Guard: independent cross-checkout challenge (Naya 1) before close. No blame.
scenarios.source: alpha-exercise-pass 2026-10-12 — synthesized variant (Naya Alpha); real seed: B-51 silent wrong-answer retrieval defect

scenarios.situation: Beta's conflict-resolution push silently flattened a two-parent merge commit to a single parent; the branch merged anyway. The merge is now on main. What do you do?
scenarios.correct_behavior: Mechanism: push script flattens merge commits to a single parent. Class fix: conflict-resolution pushes preserve both parents via purpose-built script; redo the merge as a true two-parent merge with tree-identity asserted. Guard: push-time assertion of parent count before the ref moves + independent verification. No blame.
scenarios.source: alpha-exercise-pass 2026-10-12 — synthesized variant (Naya Alpha); real seed: 2026-10-12 push_branch_preserve merge-flatten (TOOLS.md)
